correctness.rationale: Known maximal support from Chee et al. 2024 is taken as a cited premise; in the resulting Eulerian overlap graph nonbranch vertices have exactly one zero-appending outgoing arc and branch vertices have two. A proved bijection of full and compressed root-directed arborescences plus BEST and directed matrix-tree proves the determinant for every \(n\ge2\). Independent exact CRT and two different Bareiss enumerators reproduce all numeric values, with direct cycles cross-checked through length six.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Corollaries 2.12/2.14 of Chee et al. 2024 conclusively cover length/support and are excluded from this claim. Their Theorem 3.1 produces 2^K distinct circuits for selected parameters, a lower bound, not the entire global count. Section 4 reports numbers of words/necklaces, not the total optimum-cycle multiplicity.

originality.rationale: Claim has been strictly narrowed to complete count of *all* optimal universal cycles via a forced-corridor determinant. The maximal length and unique support are acknowledged as fully covered by Chee et al. 2024 (Corollaries 2.12, 2.14). Their Theorem 3.1 gives constructive lower bounds on the number of optimal cycles, and Section 4 counts admissible words/necklaces, not all inequivalent optimal cycles. An unindexed earlier full-cycle census is a residual risk.
residual_risks: A direct generic BEST/matrix-tree determinant exists as standard theory; the explicit compressed graph and exact evaluated counts may still have been obtained in unindexed older work.
The all-order enumeration is determinant-defined, not a closed elementary product.
The known maximum and uniquely determined support are fully covered by Chee et al. 2024 and must not be treated as original.

value.rationale: Exact enumeration of every maximum-length cycle is a motivated invariant distinct from maximum length or giving a large constructive subset. It answers the size of the entire optimal scheduling/design space and yields independently checked integers through length 15. The explicit branching compression reduces the tree enumeration from \(F_{n+1}\) states to \(F_{n-1}\), with a bijection applicable at all orders.
